title: SceneComposer Architecture, Multi-Scene Orchestration & Public API Reference

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/SCENE_COMPOSER_ARCHITECTURE_AND_API.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/SCENE_COMPOSER_ARCHITECTURE_AND_API.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

The [`SceneComposer`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/SceneComposer.ts) is the top-level composition coordinator and master hardware orchestrator of the Retiam WebGPU engine. It owns the WebGPU execution context, manages the target canvas, coordinates the render loop, and aggregates multiple independent [`Scene`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Scene.ts) instances into a unified, depth-sorted output—analogous to a master Composition in Adobe After Effects.
Retiam strictly separates **hardware ownership and composition orchestration** from **timeline scripting and animation logic**:

items: **Single Source of Truth for GPU Hardware**: All WebGPU objects (`GPUDevice`, `GPUCanvasContext`, `Renderer`, `Compute`, `StateDataManager`, `GlobalGeometryAllocator`, `GlobalAnalyticalAllocator`) are owned exclusively by `SceneComposer`. Individual `Scene` instances only hold non-owning back-references injected at attachment time.

**Multi-Scene Layering & Composition**: Scenes in the composer stack are ordered by $Z$-index (`sceneEntries`). Each scene can possess its own camera, projection parameters, clear color, and global opacity (`ALPHA`), enabling multi-layered rendering (e.g. 3D simulation with an orthographic HUD overlay, split-screen cameras, or crossfading transitions).

**Idle-Smart On-Demand Rendering**: Rather than running an unconstrained 60/144 FPS game loop when the screen is static, `SceneComposer` renders only when visual state is dirty, saving battery and CPU/GPU cycles.

**Zero Minor GC Allocations During Traversal**: Pre-allocates object pools for intermediate transforms (`statePool`), render descriptors (`renderCommandPool`), and scissor clipping boxes (`aabbPool`).

**Headless & Offline Auto-Routing**: Automatically inspects URL query parameters (`?offline=true`, `?renderConfig=...`) and environment features to switch seamlessly between real-time browser preview and headless WebSocket frame-streaming to FFmpeg.

blocks.text: The core execution method [`buildRenderQueues()`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/SceneComposer.ts#L975-L1006) coordinates the transformation of abstract scene graphs into hardware draw commands:

blocks.code:
flowchart TD
    A["buildRenderQueues()"] --> B["Reset stateManager & Command Pools"]
    B --> C["For each Scene in sceneEntries (sorted by zIndex)"]
    C --> D["Apply scene.ALPHA to baseState"]
    D --> E["Merge scene.compute_queue into composer.compute_queue"]
    E --> F["For each root entity in scene.entities: traverse(entity)"]
    
    F --> G{"entity.VISIBILITY && opacity > 0?"}
    G -->|"No"| H["Cull Subtree"]
    G -->|"Yes"| I{"Has RendererComponent?"}
    
    I -->|"Yes"| J["Acquire pooled RenderCommand & allocateDirect State"]
    I -->|"No"| K["Acquire pooled State from statePool"]
    
    J --> L["worldState.apply(entity.state, parentState)"]
    K --> L
    
    L --> M["Auto-increment monotonic Z-Index: z_index += 0.0002"]
    M --> N["Intersect entity.scissorClipRect with parent AABB"]
    N --> O["renderer.prepare(composer, geo, frag, worldState)"]
    O --> P["Push cmd to render_queue"]
    P --> Q["Recurse on entity.children"]

items: **Monotonic Auto $Z$-Index**: If an entity does not specify `_zIndexExplicit = true`, traversal automatically increments `this.z_index += this.delta` (0.0002). This ensures that visual drawing order naturally matches scene graph insertion order without z-fighting.

**Scissor Box Intersection**: If an entity or any ancestor defines `scissorClipRect`, bounding boxes are computed and intersected in screen space. All child entities inherit the clipped scissor region automatically.

**Nested Scene Traversal**: If an entity is a [`SubScene`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/SubScene.ts) (`'nestedScene' in entity`), traversal seamlessly recurses into `nestedScene.entities` using the current `worldState`.

blocks.content: **1. WebGPU Destruction Order during Vite HMR**: Never destroy entity GPU buffers while the composer's render loop is active. Doing so triggers the fatal WebGPU error: `[Invalid Buffer] Buffer used in submit while destroyed.` Always call `composer.destroy()` or `scene.destroy()`, which stops the `requestAnimationFrame` loop **before** freeing buffer pools.

**2. `ALWAYS_UPDATE` is Owned by the Composer**: Scenes do not own independent render loops. If a scene requires continuous frame updates (for physics, particle simulations, or continuous 12 FPS line boil), set `this.ALWAYS_UPDATE = true` inside the scene, which delegates directly to `this.composer.ALWAYS_UPDATE`.

**3. OffscreenCanvas in Web Workers**: When using `OffscreenCanvas` inside a Web Worker, `window` does not exist. `SceneComposer` automatically skips DOM resize listeners and device pixel ratio lookups when an `OffscreenCanvas` is passed to `init()`.
